description: Team Chuijhal is a multidisciplinary collective of innovators bridging the gap between orbit and earth. By harnessing NASA’s advanced Earth observation data—including multispectral imagery, climate models, and hydrological telemetry—our team is building actionable solutions for modern agriculture. We are dedicated to transforming complex space data into intuitive tools that empower farmers to optimize resource use, combat climate stress, and secure sustainable food systems for the future
